patch_description: The Gen 3 variant (first-improvement with shuffled iteration order) scored 3610 vs the current best-improvement variant's 3597, confirming the recommendation. First-improvement accepts the first improving relocation immediately and breaks the inner loop, dramatically cutting cost queries per round. This allows more restarts within the same 100-second budget (cap raised to 45), each with a full local search plus a final best-improvement polish pass per restart to refine the local optimum. Greedy construction stays as the seeded starting point, and the time deadline still guards the total budget.
